name: Indirect Prompt Injection
summary: Adversaries may deliver malicious prompts to an LLM indirectly by embedding the prompts in content that the adversary expects may be processed by an LLM. These prompts can be included in web pages, documents, emails, tickets, code, or other sources that an agent, copilot, or other AI system may retrieve and process.
